description: Cast a Qi Men chart for every double-hour of the next few days and rank them for a goal, using the person's Day Master from the birth date. Returns the top windows with date, hour branch, true-solar-time range, score and the lucky direction at that time.

days.description: How many days ahead to scan, 1-7. Default 7.

focus.description: Goal to rank for. Default general.

longitude.description: Longitude of where the person is now, east positive. Default 120 (Beijing meridian).

top.description: How many windows to return, 1-10. Default 5.

name: best_times
title: Best upcoming double-hours
